# @donglegeyu/company-mobile-ui

> 企业级移动端 React 组件库，基于 Ant Design Mobile 5.x 深度定制，品牌主色 `#F95914`。82 个基础组件 + 1 个共享组件，统一品牌令牌，严格使用规则。**主题由 CSS 变量（`--adm-color-*`）驱动，不是 React Context。**

## Installation

```bash
npm install @donglegeyu/company-mobile-ui
```

Peer dependencies: `antd-mobile >=5.0.0`, `react >=18.0.0`, `react-dom >=18.0.0`.

## Minimal Setup

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { MobileThemeProvider, MobileButton } from '@donglegeyu/company-mobile-ui';

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(
  <MobileThemeProvider>
    <MobileButton color="primary">Brand Button</MobileButton>
  </MobileThemeProvider>
);
```

主题色无需额外配置：`import "@donglegeyu/company-mobile-ui"` 即自动注入 `global.css`，在 `:root` 定义 `--adm-color-*` 品牌变量。`MobileThemeProvider` 仅用于 locale（语言包）。

## Critical Rules for AI Agents

1. NEVER use antd-mobile native components directly. Always use MobileXxx (e.g. MobileButton, not Button). `import type { ButtonProps } from 'antd-mobile'` type imports are allowed. `ConfigProvider` is allowed ONLY for locale.
2. NEVER hardcode colors. Use CSS variables `var(--adm-color-*)` / `var(--mobile-color-*)` or the `mobileDesignRules` constant. For local theme overrides use `generateMobileThemeVars()` passed to a container style.
3. NEVER use `!important` in styles. Use inline style (naturally higher specificity) or CSS Modules compliant nested selectors.
4. NEVER use the `any` type. Define explicit TypeScript interfaces.
5. NEVER use default exports. Always use named exports (export function / export const).
6. `ConfigProvider` only takes `locale`. NEVER pass a `theme` prop (antd-mobile v5 silently ignores it).
7. Mobile hard rules: tappable elements ≥ 44×44 (`--mobile-touch-target`); edge-sticking components use `.mobile-safe-area-top` / `.mobile-safe-area-bottom`; use only `px` units (project ships postcss-px-to-viewport-8-plugin — never mix rem/em/vw); never use PC-only events (`onMouseEnter` / `onMouseLeave` / `onDoubleClick` — use onClick/onTouchStart); add `-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent` to tappable elements.
8. Business templates take priority over basic components: business templates (building) → shared components (MobileIconExplorer) → basic components (MobileButton / MobileInput / MobileList, 82 total).
9. When unsure about component props, read the installed type definitions at `node_modules/@donglegeyu/company-mobile-ui/dist/es/index.d.ts` — do not write from memory. Otherwise look up the component section in llms-full.txt.
10. After generating code, run the validator until 0 errors (governance loop stage ③):
    `curl -O https://raw.githubusercontent.com/donglegeyu/company-mobile-ui-skills/main/scripts/ai-lint.mjs && node ai-lint.mjs src/`

### Allowed antd-mobile imports (no MobileXxx wrapper or special case):

`ConfigProvider` (locale only) — plus `import type { ...Props } from 'antd-mobile'` type imports.

### Template priority order (highest first):

1. **Business templates**: building (template-components directory is in place)
2. **Shared components**: `MobileIconExplorer` (icon explorer)
3. **Basic components**: MobileButton / MobileInput / MobileList ... (82 total) — manual assembly only when templates can't cover the use case

## Theme Mechanism — KEY DIFFERENCE from PC antd

| Dimension | PC antd | Mobile antd-mobile v5 |
|---|---|---|
| Theme driver | React Context (`theme.useToken()`) | **CSS variables** (`--adm-color-*`) |
| ConfigProvider | supports `theme` prop | **does NOT** support `theme` prop, only `locale` |
| Default primary | controlled by theme | `#1677ff` (read via CSS variable) |
| Runtime token read | `theme.useToken()` | CSS variable `var(--adm-color-primary)` or `mobileDesignRules` constant |
| Local override | `ConfigProvider theme` | `generateMobileThemeVars()` → CSS var object as container `style` |

```tsx
// ❌ WRONG (silently ignored)
<ConfigProvider theme={themeConfig}>{/* ... */}</ConfigProvider>

// ✅ CORRECT — local theme override
import { generateMobileThemeVars, MobileButton } from '@donglegeyu/company-mobile-ui';
export const NestedThemeExample = () => (
  <div style={generateMobileThemeVars()}>
    <MobileButton color="primary">局部主题色按钮</MobileButton>
  </div>
);
```

## Mobile Design Tokens (CSS variables)

| Token | Value | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| `--adm-color-primary` | `#F95914` | Brand primary (global; overrides antd-mobile default blue `#1677ff`) |
| `--adm-color-wathet` | `#FFF1E6` | Light-orange background (selected state / background) |
| `--adm-color-success` | `#00B42A` | Success |
| `--adm-color-warning` | `#FF7D00` | Warning |
| `--adm-color-danger` | `#F53F3F` | Danger |
| `--mobile-color-primary-hover` | `#E04E0E` | Pressed state |
| `--mobile-touch-target` | `44px` | Min tappable target (Apple HIG) |
| `--mobile-radius-base` | `8px` | Base radius (sm 6 / base 8 / lg 12 / full 9999) |

Runtime reads (priority high→low): CSS variable `var(--adm-color-primary)` → `mobileDesignRules.colors.brand` → `useMobileToken()`.

## Mobile-Specific Rules

1. Tappable targets ≥ 44×44 (`--mobile-touch-target` / `mobileDesignRules.touchTarget`)
2. Safe-area: `.mobile-safe-area-top` / `.mobile-safe-area-bottom` / `env(safe-area-inset-*)`
3. `px` units only (postcss-px-to-viewport-8-plugin configured; never mix rem/em/vw)
4. No PC events (`onMouseEnter` / `onMouseLeave` / `onDoubleClick`); use onClick/onTouchStart
5. `-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent` on tappable elements (body already global)
